name: Amodal Cityscapes
description: A dataset and challenge for amodal semantic segmentation in urban street scenes, providing annotations and baseline evaluation for predicting full object masks including occluded parts.
evaluation_method: mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) for amodal masks (per-class IoU metrics)
general_score_metric: mean IoU (mIoU) on amodal mask predictions
reputation: A respected, specialized extension of Cityscapes for amodal segmentation used by researchers studying occlusion and amodal perception in urban scenes.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark with specialized amodal annotations; smaller, task-specific splits and annotation ambiguity around occluded parts can affect evaluation and comparability.
